shortDescription: Attach/detach a volume to a device in the Packet host

options.name: auth_token
options.description: Packet API token. You can also supply it in environment variable E(PACKET_API_TOKEN).

options.name: device
options.description: Selector for the device. It can be a UUID of the device, or a hostname. Example values: 98a14f7a-3d27-4478-b7cf-35b5670523f3, "my device".

options.name: project_id
options.description: UUID of the project to which the device and volume belong.

options.name: state
options.description: Indicate desired state of the attachment.

options.name: volume
options.description: Selector for the volume. It can be a UUID, an API-generated volume name, or user-defined description string. Example values: V(4a347482-b546-4f67-8300-fb5018ef0c5), V(volume-4a347482), V(my volume).
